reason: v6 has reproducible phase regression; v7 has substantial p95 increase in a small case, so evidence is insufficient to establish the requested non-regression. Do not offset this with faster other cases.
scope: Two grid seeds, 8 grid classes plus dense positive/intersection states; both full updates+query, no whole-engine latency claim.

protocol.main_boundary: both full vertex updates followed by complete distance and witness
protocol.order_balance: pair order changes every two geometry states; each phase sees AB and BA in every process
protocol.cold_boundary: two independent indexes and the first complete query
protocol.stage_boundary: separate update and query instrumentation, outside main samples
protocol.quality: distance equality plus independent barycentric witness membership and analytic dense gaps
protocol.input_ownership_check: both states and topology hashed after each method, outside timing; mutation aborts the case before the opponent runs
protocol.ci_statistic: median of paired candidate-minus-implementation time differences
protocol.ci_resampling: paired samples resampled within each process; pooled CI stratified by process
protocol.ci_scope: conditional on measured processes; not a machine-population or future-run interval
protocol.acceptance: no performance thresholds decided by this script; reviewer must assess both layers

limitations: p95 increase is observed, not a proof of universal algorithmic slowdown.
No statistically positive phase median alone establishes non-regression of p95.
Memory/RSS and whole observation-action-learning latency are not measured in this BC gate.
Exploratory source snapshots/logs remain in local artifacts/bc_refinement; formal v6/v7 code and full timing samples are public.

structural_diagnostics.purpose: Untimed structural work counts; not latency evidence
